text:
jia.chen: quick sync0: customer reported duplicate operations in the uploads sample. looks related to retries after auth refresh + 429.

kai: can you paste the short repro?

jia.chen: minimal: client POST /v1/uploads -> 429 -> client triggers token refresh -> refresh ok -> sdk retries POST -> backend processed twice. no idempotency-key used in sample.

morgan: this smells like a parity issue again. node sdk blocked auth-triggered replays last year; go sdk currently retries unguarded.

alex.w: sample app onboarding tends to hide idempotency key usage; new users copy paste the quickstart which doesn't set Idempotency-Key by default.

kai: actionable: standardize SDK behavior: default deny replay of mutating requests after auth refresh unless Idempotency-Key present or client opt-in. log an event when blocked.

jia.chen: propose API config: {"replay": {"auth_guard": true, "allow_auth_replay": false, "jitter_ms": "100-400"}} (docs only, not actual nested JSON here). default jitter window 100-400ms.

morgan: prefer smaller upper bound for low-latency apps, 100-300ms. make it per-client adjustable. also prefer uniform jitter for first retry, then exp backoff.

kai: tests to add for parity: node vs go vs python.

jia.chen: i'll open a parity PR for go and python to match node guard. include: unit tests, e2e against sample uploads harness, telemetry event name `auth_replay_blocked`.

alex.w: sample app changes: add clear quickstart note + code snippet for Idempotency-Key header. also add a small migration blurb to changelog.

morgan: edge-case: streaming bodies where the SDK streams the body to socket before failure. we should not attempt to replay if body was streamed. make that explicit.

kai: agree. rule-of-thumb: only auto-retry when body can be replayed safely (buffered small JSON or idempotency key present).

jia.chen: CI plan: run smoke e2e before merging, add flaky test guard. I'll target next sprint.

devops-bot: CI queued for branch: dx/auth-replay-guard (job 901)

morgan: after roll, monitor telemetry for `auth_replay_blocked` count and customer support hits.

alex.w: I'll notify the customer with mitigation steps: 1) add Idempotency-Key header; 2) pin sdk config to previous behaviour if they explicitly need it (not recommended).

jia.chen: assigning to self, tagging @morgan @kai for review. will post PR link here.

kai: small follow-up: consider a runtime opt-in for partners that use a proxy to enforce idempotency at the edge. needs an RFC.

jia.chen: noted, add RFC section. thanks everyone.
